retirement_age.notes: State Pension age is 66; the contributory pension can be claimed at any age between 66 and 70. Earlier plans to raise the age to 67 and 68 were dropped and the Government stated its intention to keep it at 66. There is no general mandatory retirement age; employers may set their own.
